# Wonka AI Usage Audit

Local AI usage audit CLI for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and local Git signals.

## What It Does

Creates pre-training and post-training usage baselines to measure whether AI habits improved after Wonka workshops. Measures real work context, workflow orientation, and validation practices — not token consumption.

## Stack

- Node.js >=18 (ES modules)
- Zero runtime dependencies
- Python 3 (optional, for premium PDF reports)

## Key Entrypoints

- `src/cli.js` — main CLI entry point
- `src/collectors/` — data collectors (claude-code.js, codex.js, cursor.js, git.js)
- `src/metrics/score.js` — scoring model and KPI calculation
- `src/reports/` — report generators (pdf.js, html.js, markdown.js, linkedin.js, card-svg.js)
- `scripts/` — Python report builders (build_premium_report.py, build_client_report.py)
- `schemas/` — JSON schemas (audit-export.schema.json, enterprise-aggregate.schema.json)

## Install And Run

```bash
npx wonka-audit
```

## Common Commands

```bash
npx wonka-audit --preview              # Preview detected sources
npx wonka-audit --explain-privacy      # Print privacy model
npx wonka-audit --out ./wonka-audit    # Custom output directory
npx wonka-audit --share                # Generate private report + public website
```

## Privacy Model

Local-first. No automatic upload. Users own their generated reports. See README for details.
